meaning: System qualities are 15 orthogonal axes and candidate assurance, not installed certified release
Twelve principal quality conclusions preserve five truth statuses and one application execution spine
Exact package version drift, false listdir empty, non-sandbox root, whole-object copy and Qt/JSON gaps
Implementation owners, research consensus and future architecture proposals have distinct evidentiary statuses
Threats span untrusted archives, paths, lost ACK, zombie workers, ACL, secret bundles, source prompt injection
Lifecycle, terminal/effect/domain/health/attention, typed fail classes, partial and unknown differ
Six effect classes and destructive preflight/plan/approval/revalidation/staging/receipt safety
LocalFileStore.listdir returns [] for nonexisting or wrong-type; local root helper does not sandbox
Two-phase verified artifact staging/content + catalog with orphan/unknown reconciliation
Service recovery has 12 checks; client reconnect, worker retry and disaster restore differ
DomainEvent, Progress, Finding, Problem, Log, Audit, Condition, Notification distinct owners and recipients
Coalesced progress, bounded physically persisted logs, privacy audiences, SupportBundle and SLI candidates
Principal/Actor/Session/Node distinct, effect-scoped permissions and provider trust, Web auth and machine boundary
State/resource/worker custody/publication concurrency separate; retry/replay/dedup and civil scheduler differ
Durability, transaction uniqueness, opaque ACL stream cursor, version vectors, drift and safe data migration
Streaming/resource quotas, actual benchmarks, accessible focus/reduced motion/localization are unverified
Fifty SB-Q candidate invariants in semantic/effect/durability/security/operability families
C08 twenty conceptual conflicts and historical anti-patterns retain exact source status
R08 eighteen prioritized risk diagnoses, not incidents or proven exploit impacts
F01–F36 fault-injection tests proposed, no dynamic execution evidence
G08-01–26 open decisions and eight distinct Product approvals remain unaccepted
Six proposed quality implementation gates A–F are not approved roadmap
Primary code, dependent studies and external standards maintain distinct provenance
Ten after-failure accountability questions determine readiness better than feature flags
